answer_1.quote: We introduce two controllable text-to-text generation tasks on the dataset: (1) generating and (2) reframing unhelpful thoughts, given a persona and pattern as the context.
answer_1.outputs: unhelpful thoughts and reframed thoughts conditioned on personas and thought patterns

answer_2.quote: Following previous work on text reframing, we report BLEU, ROUGE, and BERTScore, which capture the semantic similarity between the generated thought and the human reference. We also report distinct-1, and distinct-2 metrics to measure the diversity of the generations.

answer_4.quote: We collect human ratings of 100 random thoughts from the test set. Similar to previous style transfer works, we evaluate the generated rewrites along three dimensions through Yes/No binary ratings
answer_4.guideline: We evaluate the generated rewrites along three dimensions through Yes/No binary ratings: (i) fluency, which evaluates the readability of the generation, (ii) meaning preservation, which here verifies if the rewrite aligns with the given persona and thought, and (iii) quality, which here evaluates if the generated thought exhibits the given unhelpful thought pattern.
